title_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 健康科技學院 副教授 ‧ 台灣醫療救護學會 秘書長
title_en: Associate Professor, College of Health Technology, National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Sciences ‧ Secretary-General, Taiwan Society of Paramedicine
tags_zh: 智慧醫療與 VR 應用
about_zh: 張育通博士現任國立臺北護理健康大學健康科技學院副教授，並兼任台灣醫療救護學會秘書長。國立臺灣師範大學教育學博士（健康促進與衛生教育）、澳洲 Monash University 救護學學士，具 20 年新北市政府消防局救護技術員實務經驗，並曾任亞東紀念醫院災難管理專員，負責全院緊急應變規劃、DMAT 建置與演訓。研究以行為科學、健康科技與生物統計為方法，聚焦到院前緊急救護、災難管理、救護人員職業安全與心理健康，以及 EMS 資料之空間分析，並持續推動醫療救護人員專業發展與創新數位學習。
about_en: Dr. Yu-Tung Chang is an Associate Professor at the College of Health Technology, National Taipei University of Nursing and Health Sciences, and Secretary-General of the Taiwan Society of Paramedicine. He holds a Doctorate in Education (Health Promotion and Health Education) from National Taiwan Normal University and a Bachelor of Emergency Health (Paramedic) from Monash University, served 20 years as an EMT with the New Taipei City Fire Department, and spent four years as disaster management specialist at Far Eastern Memorial Hospital, leading hospital-wide emergency planning and DMAT development. His research applies behavioural science, health technology and biostatistics to prehospital care, disaster management, EMS workforce safety and mental health, and spatial analysis of EMS data.
